name: Tenaron's Summons
summary: In Shadowglen, Tenaron's Summons calls you to Aldrassil. After helping Gilshalan Windwalker with woodland dangers, you are asked to meet Tenaron Stormgrip high in the great tree. The call draws you from local troubles toward the spiritual afflictions touching Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Call to the Boughs
sections.body: Your work against the venomous spiders and corrupted wildlife in the glen has reached Tenaron Stormgrip. Gilshalan Windwalker tells you the elder has asked for your presence. Even night elves, with their long lives, know better than to keep an elder waiting atop Aldrassil.

sections.title: Ascending Aldrassil
sections.body: Tenaron waits in Aldrassil's highest chamber, looking across Shadowglen's boughs. Meeting him brings you into wider concerns of stewardship, including the cleansing of Teldrassil's moonwells and the corruption spreading through the young World Tree's ecosystem.

faq.answer: Tenaron Stormgrip is a night elf who lives in Aldrassil's highest chamber in Shadowglen. He oversees the glen's spiritual care and efforts to watch over and cleanse Teldrassil's sacred waters.

faq.q: Where do I find Tenaron Stormgrip?
faq.answer: Tenaron Stormgrip waits in the highest room of Aldrassil, the great hollow tree in Shadowglen. Climb the winding ramps inside to reach his chamber near the crown.
After you prove yourself against the blighted wildlife below, Tenaron gives you greater responsibilities. He asks you to investigate the sacred moonwells and test their waters for corruption.
Meeting Tenaron leads into the Crown of the Earth storyline. He asks you to collect water samples from moonwells across Teldrassil and check the tree's health.
Gilshalan Windwalker sends you to Tenaron after you help him with the venom-crazed Webwood spiders threatening Shadowglen's lower hollows.
Aldrassil is a great tree in Shadowglen, with a hollow trunk that holds the central settlement and training sanctuary for young night elves on Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf, this call marks your coming of age among the kaldorei. You move from defending the woods to serving the elders who tend the World Tree.
Meeting Tenaron Stormgrip helps you learn how druids watch over and maintain Teldrassil's balance.
